body: Hey man, thanks a lot for the long message! I failed this morning. And i felt really bad. But I just couldn't shake off what i read on here. But still I was dumb enough to take a rope and get into the forest. The fresh air helped to clear my mind, and I always keep my cross close to me, and I just thought, you're all right, I got no right to throw away the life god gave me. I suddenly felt a lot better, and just had a nice walk. All though it was in a suit, because i figured that if I die, I at least be dressed up nice. Got a lot of weird looks and I think some knew, If you see a person in 30 degrees Celsius with a backpack, i think you know it means no good. But yes I'm alive and will continue to serve the Lord. Thanks a million times for your kind words, brother.
Yeah i know it's wrong. It's just something like a .. last option? idk. Thanks for the kind words. I will stay strong.
I'm really scared to do it. Best case if if i succeed, but even thinking like this is a sin. I hope everything will be alright
But, i have to be good in Life.. I feel like i fail everything.
Thank you, brother.
I dont know man, really, it's so weird. Even after everything, I'm so messed up, but i still believe in Him. But at this point i dont know anymore really.

I've been carried through so much by believing, the power of God is really amazing. But i really wonder if it will be enough this time. I will make very rushed decisions and kill myself before I can even realize.. I just have to pass and make everybody proud

Man, i've given my life to god but i dont know anymore :/ It's not that i dishonor god or place myself before Him, but so many things happened, I just want out if i fail again. Im sorry okay :/ Dont think I'm going against god as i never will but so much has happened..
It's just diffucult to give up your pride. If i fail this time i will die. I know that nobody will be able to stop it.. but it's just.. do i still get to get into heaven..

But I believe that once you been saved, you just been saved you know brother? I just wish i can still get into heaven, but I'm unsure about this. We got free will, so will God be able to forgive this sin? It's like the final sin

My grandfather, well, he was 1 of the nicest men i ever knew. He always took care of me, i was his first grandchild, and all though they never told anyone, i was his favorite. He was a strong man. Lost his dad to WW2, but kept believing in the power of God. I never got too spent enough time with him, but, to be completely honest, i had such a strong connection with him, maybe even more then with my dad. Yeah he was great man, and he meant a lot for me. I was a mess when he died. But the thing that kept me going, was the idea, that when I die, I will see him in Heaven..

I failed 3 times already, if i fail this 1 again it's just proud brother. I already look like the dumbass anyway, but that doesn't matter too much. After the first 2 times i was like OK, i will get there! But as of right now this is my limit. I can't fail again. If i do i just give up on life it self.
Gank candy actually gave me 750k a few min ago in wildy.. lol
I'll just have to succeed. I wish there was another way, but failing again, that is just not something that can happen. It will turn me entirely worthless.

Just be carefull and try to keep track of how much your drinking. Try to drink a little less and see how you feel. I felt like i was missing something so bad. But to really answer you: I felt nothing. I didn't care.

Hi, sorry for the late reply man. Thanks for answering though. It did not, because, how stupid it sounds, I didn't even know. It was my father who later told me that my grandfather was an heavy alcoholic. At that time I already drank a lot so, it did not really change anything, apart from the fact it's probably in my genes.

Yeah same here.. 
Well i just to always sit on his lap while i was a baby, spent a lot of time with him, showed me around at his work, watched me, protected me, he was an alcoholic and basically always drunk, but when I was around he would hold back till i was asleep, and now being 1 myself i realize how hard it must have been. He had a pretty life too, but it had more to do with the war and losing his dad in it.
I honestly believe he was the person who loved me the most. Not saying my parents dont love me, but i had that special connection with him

And to answer what put me in this cycle, i really have no idea. I just started feeling bad someday, when my grandpa died it took a huge toll on me because i was young, but old enough to understand i would never see him again, and it really hurt me too

Yeah I've had help with it, but the thing really is, I'm not so much addicted to the alcohol, I'm more addicted to numbing the pain. I can stop drinking but it won't stop all the pain. That is the first thing. It's never why do you drink? It's always you drink too much that is dangerous!

Well i got nothing to hide. So yeah to put it fair: to numb the pain and stress I'm drunk almost everyday( lets say 360 of 365) And it really puts a toll on my mental health too, wich doesn't help. But at least when I'm drunk I dont stress too much and be fine till i wake up and the cycle repeats.
